devices.title: Logged in devices
devices.subtitle: Devices currently signed into your PocketShell account.
devices.action_message: Choose what to do with this device. "Log out" signs it out but keeps its access to your hosts. "Revoke access" also removes it from every host you've paired (requires email verification).
devices.revoke_otp_message: We sent a 6-digit code to your email. Enter it to revoke access for {{name}}.
devices.empty_subtitle: We couldn't find any active devices for your account.
devices.footnote: Logging out blocks the device from your account. Revoking access also removes its trust on every paired host.
delete_account_confirm_body: This permanently deletes your PocketShell account, paired hosts, sessions, and chat history. This cannot be undone.
delete_account_failed: Failed to delete account. Please contact support.
delete_account_reason_text_placeholder: Anything else you'd like to share? (optional)
delete_account_otp_prompt: Enter the 6-digit code we just emailed you
delete_account_otp_send_failed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
delete_account_otp_invalid: That code didn't work. Check your email and try again.
